title: Stoke the Fire
subtitle: Repeatable, with a cooldown
description: A hexagonal node with a cooldown ring around it. Four coal every two
minutes, forever -- which is not much, and is the point: a repeatable
job should pay for the walk.
`repeatCooldownTicks: 2400` is two minutes. A repeatable quest's
completion count survives each completion, so anything depending on
it stays satisfied while you keep working it.
The icon is at iconScale 0.55, so it sits smaller in its node than
the quests around it -- how a minor, repeatable job is told apart
from a one-off milestone at a glance.
